outcome: perioperative data (port-placement time, arm configurations, docking time, console time)
cohort: 60 patients who underwent elective robotic surgeries for benign gynecological conditions, primarily pelvic endometriosis, hysterectomies, and adnexal surgery.
finding: The study found that learning curves for using the Hugo(tm) RAS system, including port placement, arm positioning, docking, and procedure time, can be rapidly adapted, although the technology is still considered to be in its learning curve period.
